activity-date.narrative: KEN 2 will focus on Rrising awareness about SRHR among young women and girls in order to make informed decisions about their bodies and lives. This includes understanding their reproductive health, contraception options, safe sex practices, and their rights under national and international law. The intervention considers also advocacy activities, where efforts will lead into the domestication of national frameworks and laws into country legislations that are critical for ensuring SRHR at the local level. This means traslating national policies and laws into county-specific ordinances and regulations, and ensuring that they are adequately funded and implemented. Mobilizing and organizing young women and girls to engage in positive discourse on SRHR is essential for amplifying their voices and shaping the narrative around SRHR issues. Results from Oct 2025 - 2028; The short-term outcomes are increased awareness, knowledge, and uptake of SRHR information and services among young women and girls in all their diversities. The other short-term outcome is strengthened partnerships and civil societies engagement with the state to ensure prioritisation of SRHR services and information. The third short term is strengthened movements of SRHR actors in the advocacy of laws and policies on SRHR in Kenya. With the anti-gender movements camping in Kenyaand opposing all the progressive laws and policies in Kenya working closely on issues deemed contentious will support in strengthening the SRHR movements in Kenya and beyond.
